text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their fierce battle electrified the hearts 
of everyone present.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The racers themselves felt the exact same 
way. To think that racing a rival could be 
so heart-stirring and ignite such a 
burning desire not to lose.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A single tear gleams in Maruzensky's eye. 
It is unmistakable proof that they had 
competed with all their might.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two formed a new promise. To 
compete once again... as rivals.
